...A STRONG THUNDERSTORM WILL IMPACT PORTIONS OF PORTER COUNTY UNTIL 
400 PM CDT...

At 300 PM CDT, a strong thunderstorm was located near Hebron, or 13
miles southeast of Crown Point, moving northeast at 40 mph.

Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and pea size hail are possible with this
storm.

Locations impacted include...
Portage, Valparaiso, Chesterton, Lakes of the Four Seasons, South
Haven, Porter, Hebron and Shorewood Forest.

If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.
